about: D-score structure, element group values, stick bonus, connection value and requirements of WG MAG 2025-2028, current to MAG Newsletter 4 (July 2026). Own words; digest of composition.md. 'cite' is the printed page and article, or the newsletter and its page. 'since' is the date a newsletter rule takes effect; 'code_rule' keeps what the Code said before.
short_exercise_cite: p. 14 §6.3 (table read from the page image)

element_groups.required: one element of each EG (FX: 4 EGs; others: I-III plus dismount group IV)

cancelled_by: heels or toes raised to keep balance

none_for: two single saltos with twists in a row

FX.label: a double or triple salto counted in the routine (seniors: the dismount)
a balance on one leg, or a jump/leap from the newsletter list; need not be a counting element
FX.ucg_cite: UCG MAG Rules Breakdown, Balance/Corner Requirement row (Advanced only; Nate, 2026-10-20)
excluded: stag leaps with or without turn (MAG-NL-3 p. 3)
conditions: jumps with turns to front support take off from two feet
jumps to support land on the hands under control (0.1/0.3/0.5 and NR)

code_rule.label: a one-leg balance, I.61 or I.62

FX.cite: MAG-NL-1 pp. 2, 9; MAG-NL-3 p. 3; MAG-NL-4 p. 2

FX.label: the first element is a tumbling pass
all corner transitions different (stag leaps, sissonnes, split jumps each count as one kind from 2026-09-01)
FX.cite: MAG-NL-1 p. 3; MAG-NL-3 p. 2; MAG-NL-4 p. 2

FX.label: go to and/or from every corner; same diagonal at most twice in a row

SR.label: one swing to handstand (2 s) among the counting elements

FX.what: strength element (I.1-I.48 except I.19 and I.31)

SR.what: EG II/III elements in direct succession, unless a recognised B+ EG I swing element (not a kip) comes between

PB.what: body/regrasp variant of one salto element per EG

HB.what: grip variant of one turning element
flights of each style: Tkatchev/Piatti, Kovacs (incl. II.82, II.83), Gienger, Jager, Markelov, front saltos over the bar
a 5th flight counts only when two flights are done back to back (C+C or better)

PB.what: jump from the floor to L-sit

PB.cite: MAG-NL-3 p. 4 (badge read from the page image)

juniors_prohibited.what: PB saltos landing in upper arms or bent-arm support
